_comment: Default values for dashboard preferences that are persisted per-browser in localStorage. Read at init by the dashboard via GET /api/ui-defaults; used ONLY when the corresponding localStorage key is absent (first visit or after Settings → Clear Local Storage & Cookies). User toggles in the Settings popover always override and persist locally. Change a value here to shift the default for first-time visitors across all browsers served by this install. EXCEPTION: dialogMaxHeightPx below is not a localStorage-backed preference — see its own comment.
_dialogMaxHeightPx_comment: Maximum height, in pixels, of EVERY dialog in the dashboard — both dialog families (.modal in style.css and .9mm-pos-mgr-modal in 9mm-pos-mgr.css, plus all their variants) and the IL/G debug popover. Past this height a dialog scrolls instead of growing until its dismiss button is pushed off-screen. Dialogs that carry a .9mm-pos-mgr-modal-body scroll just that body, so the title and the Close button stay pinned; the rest scroll as a whole, which is why the box also sets overflow-y. DELIBERATELY EXEMPT: the Disclosure (.disclaimer-box) — the user must scroll through the whole text to reach its accept/decline buttons, so bounding it would defeat its purpose. Anchored dropdown menus (Settings gear, ? Help, hover info popovers) are not dialogs and are not covered. Unlike the keys above, this is NOT persisted per-browser and is not read via /api/ui-defaults: `npm run build` bakes it into the generated public/ui-tokens.css as the --dialog-max-h custom property, so it applies on first paint with no inline styles and no runtime fetch. Per feedback_one_literal_per_shipped_default the literal lives here only — the CSS references the variable with no fallback value, so if the generated file is missing the dialogs simply revert to growing and the overlay scrolls.
